subject: english
title: Grammar 1
subtitle: Tomorrow's weather — future predictions and plans with be going to, SB pp. 12–13, TR 1.4.

content: Make predictions about the weather from a clue.
Say what you have decided to do about the weather.
Ask and answer questions about the future.
language: Use be going to for future predictions and plans: It's going to rain. I'm going to open my umbrella.
Form questions and short answers: Is it going to snow? Yes, it is.
